verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on precision/recall or other model-performance metrics computed on a customer's traffic, and nothing on shadow-mode trials where a new model or rule runs alongside live decisions. The documented sandbox only isolates test events from production scores. That is sandbox isolation for integration testing, not a shadow evaluation on live traffic, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can measure the model itself — precision and recall on my traffic, shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions
